coverage_notes: Sections 7.1(b), 7.1(c), and 7.2 contain operative liability allocations, dispute allocation, discretionary enforcement powers, reporting/record-retention duties, and compensation obligations that do not correspond to an allowed activity. They are recorded as OUTSIDE_ACTIVITY_SCOPE in the paragraph audit rather than forced into an unrelated activity.
Section 7.3 is a limitation-of-liability provision and creates no behavioral duty for this activity-constraint extraction.

paragraph_audit.reason: Section 7.1(b) assigns joint and several liability for losses or damage to DeepSeek arising out of or relating to end users' specified breach. Liability allocation has no faithful allowed activity; unmatched action: bear joint and several liability for losses or damage.

Section 7.1(c) allocates disputes between the licensee and end users to those parties and releases DeepSeek, to the extent permitted by applicable law. Dispute resolution and release have no faithful allowed activity; unmatched action: resolve disputes and release DeepSeek from them.

Section 7.2(a) is a trigger for DeepSeek's discretionary enforcement measures if it believes or determines that the licensee or an end user may breach the Terms or applicable law. The discretionary enforcement power is in-scope operative material but has no faithful allowed activity; unmatched action: impose enforcement measures.

Section 7.2(b) is a trigger for DeepSeek's discretionary enforcement measures when access or use disrupts or significantly threatens the Services' functionality, security, integrity, or availability. The discretionary enforcement power has no faithful allowed activity; unmatched action: impose enforcement measures.

Section 7.2(c) makes breach of Section 6 payment obligations a trigger for DeepSeek's discretionary enforcement measures. The discretionary enforcement power has no faithful allowed activity; unmatched action: impose enforcement measures.

Section 7.2 gives DeepSeek discretion to announce enforcement results and decide whether to restore use; requires record retention, reporting to competent authorities, and cooperation with investigations for suspected legal violations or illegal activities; and assigns the licensee responsibility for specified resulting third-party liabilities and compensation for DeepSeek's rights-protection losses. These powers and duties have no faithful allowed activity; unmatched actions: announce results, decide restoration, retain and report records, cooperate with investigations, and compensate specified losses.
Section 7.3 allocates liability for specified categories of damages and caps DeepSeek's total liability; it imposes no behavioral duty or activity constraint.
